ios.desc:
Tamera is a 24-hour Camera Roll. 
Take as many photos and videos in a day.
Keep what really matters and let the rest get deleted.

• Keep your iPhone photos library tidy and lean by keeping only the videos that matter.

• Save on local and cloud storage by only keeping the pictures you really like.

• Tamera is designed with privacy at its core. It doesn't keep any local or cloud backups.

• Save and share the photos you like directly from the app

• Let Tamera delete the photos/videos you don't need

Subscription details:

* Optional Annual Plan (No commitment, cancel anytime with no charge)

Subscribe to unlock Pro features!


For any questions or concerns, please contact:

contact@fs.ma
